info.name: Sonatype Policy Waivers API
info.description: Operations tagged Policy Waivers across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: sonatype-lifecycle-openapi.yml, sonatype-iq-openapi.yml. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.

variable.description: (Required) Indicates the scope of the waiver that will be created.

request.description:
Use this method to retrieve all waivers on policy violations due to transitive dependencies for a specific component detected in a specific scan. Any one of the input parameters, i.e. componentIdentifier, packageUrl or hash is required. If more than one is provided, the system will pick them in the order specified here.

Permissions required: View IQ Elements

response.name: The response contains a list of waivers on transitive policy violations for the dependencies of the component specified, for the given scanId.

item.name: Add policy waiver by policy violation id

variable.description: (Required) Indicates the scope of the waiver. Possible values are application, organization, repository, repository_manager, repository_container.
(Required) Enter the id for the ownerType provided above. E.g. applicationId if the ownerType is application.
(Required) Enter the policyViolationId for the policy on which you want to create a waiver. Use the Policy Violation REST API or Reports REST API to obtain the policyViolationId.
